name: OrderHistory
description: Mortar order history: past orders with number, date, total, status, line items and a View order link, plus optional order-level and per-item quick actions and an optional delivery tracker (ProgressSteps bar: placed, processing, shipped, delivered); empty state when there are none.

props.orders: Order[] ({ id; number; date; total; status; href; actions?: ReactNode; progress?: ProgressStep[] (delivery stages shown as a tracker under the status); items: { id; name; image; quantity; price; href?; actions?: ReactNode }[] })
props.headingLevel: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 (default 2; each order's heading and the empty state's title)
props.empty: { title: string; description?: string; action?: ReactNode } (default "No orders yet")

contract.usage: Import { OrderHistory } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
